title: 2027 Digital Narrative PhD Summer School
institution: University of Bergen, Center for Digital Narrative
field: Digital narrative, digital culture and media studies
about: The University of Bergen's Center for Digital Narrative holds its five-day PhD summer school, themed 'Play: Theory and Practice in Digital Narrative', 31 May to 4 June 2027 in Bergen, Norway. Apply by 7 January with a 300-word abstract and a PhD project summary.
requirements: Currently enrolled in a doctoral programme

upskill.name: AI for Education Academy
why: "Currently enrolled in a doctoral programme" / "Dissertation related to digital narratives" → AI for Education Academy course A010.07: "Summarize and compare scholarly materials while identifying recurring themes, methodological differences, arguments, findings, limitations, and potential research gaps" (shortlist matches were marketing courses with no genuine overlap, so linked to the Academy page, not a specific course)
